plainTranslation: The Neptune person can stir compassion in the Moon person while also confusing emotional reality. The Moon person may feel everything and still not know what is true. Boundaries are care here, not a lack of love.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
